title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Criminology
The Brantford Campus has developed a broad, comprehensive Honours BA Criminology
program
, which will suit students who wish to use criminology as a basis for a variety of different career paths.
The
Honours Criminology BA
program is only available at the Brantford Campus.
The
Honours Bachelor of Arts Criminology Combination
degree is open to all undergraduate students enrolled in another BA program at the Brantford campus.
Students who wish to complete their program in a virtual format may enrol in the
Honours Bachelor of Arts Criminology and Policing program.
The
Minor in Criminology
is available to students at all Laurier campuses through a combination of in-person and virtual programming.
